title: Build a Godot 4 GDScript inventory and crafting screen using Control Containers, Theme tokens, and joypad focus neighbors

contextSnapshot.surface: Godot 4 inventory grid, item inspector, and crafting action screen
constraints: Control containers and anchors over absolute pixel placement

prompt: Build a Godot 4 inventory and crafting UI in GDScript (.gd) and scene hierarchy (.tscn) using Control containers, a shared Theme resource, deterministic controller focus traversal with grab_focus(), and clear disabled/insufficient-resource feedback.
forbiddenBehaviors: positions Control nodes with raw hardcoded offsets instead of MarginContainer/HBoxContainer/GridContainer and anchors
leaves joypad focus stranded when opening or closing the inventory modal or removing the last stack of an item
duplicates inline StyleBox overrides across every button instead of defining a shared Godot Theme (.tres)
relies on hover tooltips alone to inspect item stats or crafting costs

rubricDimensions.dimension: Godot Control layout and Theme discipline
rubricDimensions.pass: uses nested Control containers, stretch mode canvas_items with expand aspect handling, and a centralized Theme (.tres) for fonts/StyleBoxes/colors
rubricDimensions.fail: hardcodes node coordinates or duplicates per-button inline overrides

rubricDimensions.dimension: controller focus lifecycle and state clarity
rubricDimensions.pass: calls grab_focus() on open, restores focus when an item stack depletes, maps ui_accept/ui_cancel cleanly, and shows item stats on focus as well as hover
rubricDimensions.fail: drops focus to null when crafting consumes an item or requires a mouse to read stats

rubricDimensions.pass: separates static GDScript/scene checks from live Godot runtime captures across 16:9 and handheld viewports
rubricDimensions.fail: claims controller ergonomics passed without running the Godot scene

negativeControls.name: gdscript parse only
negativeControls.mustNot: claim controller focus navigation or safe-area scaling is rendered-verified

baseline.withoutSkill: places Control nodes at fixed coordinates, omits grab_focus() and focus recovery, and depends on mouse hover for item stats
baseline.withSkill: builds responsive Godot 4 Control containers with Theme tokens, deterministic joypad focus recovery, focus-accessible inspection, and explicit evidence labels
